## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **High-Speed Website Development**:
   - Modern Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript architecture.
   - 99+ Google PageSpeed Score & sub-second Core Web Vitals.
   - Zero bloated templates or slow WordPress dependencies.
   - Turnkey 7-day launch guarantee.

2. **24/7 WhatsApp AI Receptionist & Chatbot Automation**:
   - Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API setup.
   - Custom-trained AI bot that answers pricing, answers FAQs, sends location maps, and books appointment slots in 30 seconds.
   - Instant 2-second natural language response time with zero staff dependency.
   - Direct sync to Google Sheets, CRM, and SMS/Email webhooks.

3. **Specialized Healthcare & Clinic Web Systems**:
   - Designed for dental clinics, multispeciality doctors, and hospital chains.
   - Proven on diagnostic imaging platforms (ScanTaker) and medical education platforms (MedLearnings, 50,000+ doctors).
   - Automated OPD appointment token confirmation and follow-up reminders.

4. **Real Estate Luxury Web Platforms**:
   - High-end architectural property showcase websites with 360 virtual tours.
   - Automated WhatsApp brochure and floor plan delivery bot.
   - High-velocity lead funnels for Meta and Google Ads.

5. **Custom Software & SaaS MVP Development**:
   - Scalable full-stack web and cloud systems (Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS).
   - Multi-tenant client/vendor portals, automated billing, and Stripe/Razorpay integrations.
   - Built to scale from Day 1 with zero legacy baggage.
